# V2 artifact sidecar code review — round 3

Verdict: **PASS — static code review**. All prior production correctness findings are resolved in the current frozen source. No remaining blocking code findings. This is review round3 following **two coordinated fix rounds**, on branch `android-studio-task/1-v2-artifact-facts`, base `ac58815bb268d338bea40a31fff630734cd719f4` in `/workspace/android-studio-source-providers`.

## Resolution and correctness assessment

- **Object-only wire decoding:** ObjectOnly's root deserialize entry delegates to the underlying `deserialize_map` (module lines35–58). Remote-Self derives retain Serde's native field/tag parsing; explicit trait implementations apply the adapter to all 13 object DTO/slot types plus generic CapturedField, including the streaming GeneratedRecord (lines60–73 and822–847). A positional array at any of these normal trait/sidecar-parser boundaries cannot reach the derived sequence visitor. Their real maps still use native MapAccess field decoding, so scalar/string enums, vectors, nullable primitives, map entry collections and capture content retain their ordinary representation. This is a reusable serialization-boundary correction rather than a manually duplicated schema validator. Trait Serialize forwards to the existing remote-Self derived encoding, preserving map property names, tags and value shapes. No compiler execution is claimed.
- **Streaming envelope behavior:** the top-level decoder still ignores unrelated Basic fields without materializing them as a second Basic Value tree. The known generatedArtifacts property alone is buffered as its sidecar Value. Present null remains Some(null), producing Malformed; a missing property defaults to None and produces MissingMetadata. The normal Serde object visitor retains duplicate known-field and malformed JSON rejection. The 16 MiB record bound, one-record-only requirement, schema checks, module/order equality and model-revision/identity checks remain unchanged.
- **Mandatory getter collection/map shape:** the unchanged round2 bridge verifies Map/Collection before collection conversion, inside per-getter capture. Null and wrong collection/map types therefore remain explicit unavailable capabilities rather than successful empty values. Empty SDK collections remain available-empty. Null artifacts remain Absent; nullable human-readable descriptions and Android task names remain nullable. No Java/Android container inference from paths was introduced.
- **Java task-field consistency:** both Java Android-only generation task fields require NotApplicable. Android artifacts still admit nullable or unavailable task fields. Existing Java folder applicability enforcement remains intact.
- **Version and raw fact semantics:** the original signed producer/consumer ordering domain, full-record description equality and explicit numeric comparison are retained. Assets use producer>=11.0; classpaths use producer>=8.9 OR the proved AGP8.2.0-alpha07 legacy boundary. Unknown AGP qualifiers and malformed versions stay typed. Raw root/variant/map encounter order and duplicate root paths remain preserved. Generated classpath entries stay distinct from source folders. Consumer version compatibility is checked before a usable version capability is accepted.
- **Scope and integration:** the independent sidecar does not change the public Basic ProjectModel DTO or its legacy parser. Raw generated folders remain separate from Studio visibility/light-class/KAPT filtering, Kotlin facet equivalence, on-disk root presence, selected tree rendering and original five project-view flows. No UI/controller/cache or asynchronous lifetime ownership is added. Root owns final full-app/native/full-workspace/test-parity integration gates.

## Test preservation and review

All **27 prior tests and their full source bytes are a literal prefix** of the new test file; one appended grouped positional-shape test brings the declared total to **28**. No test or assertion was removed, weakened, ignored or skipped. The two selected original ordering tests retain all nine signed tuples, every original description, Int minimum/maximum, reversed input and ordered full-record equality. Complete original AOSP files and Apache attribution remain byte-identical.

The new test exercises array envelope, producer/consumer/model-row/classpath-row positional records and capture/tagged field arrays, requiring Malformed rather than publication. Existing genuine-object tests cover ordinary successful parsing, Available(empty), artifact absence, unavailable getters, nullable Android tasks, Java NotApplicable fields, raw ordering/duplicates, stale/model identity, malformed paths/status/schema, legacy missing sidecar and unrelated Basic data.

**Nonblocking coverage observation:** the ArtifactSlot payload `["absent"]` already failed the previous adjacent-tagged sequence visitor because its second content element was missing. `["absent",null]` or `["present",<valid artifact>]` would exercise a previously accepted positional slot form. This observation does not change the code-area PASS: the slot explicitly uses the same correct map-only adapter, and the other appended cases cover previously accepted array shapes. Retain the present assertion if adding the stronger case. No slot regression was executed here.

The actual bridge-boundary regression contrasting null/wrong-type collection/map getter values with genuine empty getters remains a **runtime task acceptance gate**. Serialized Rust-null coverage cannot establish that the bridge preserves the distinction before serialization. Actual current-source SDK probe results and cleanup are also required; historical planning probes do not supply that evidence.

## Verified preservation

- All **8/8** current frozen source/test/attribution hashes matched before and after inspection.
- All **184/184** immutable original source/test/fixture/matrix hashes matched.
- All **31/31** cited pinned references and **11/11** historical probe-file identities matched the baseline.
- All **8/8** frozen round-one and **8/8** frozen round-two source copies match their respective retained snapshots; prior FAIL reports remain retained.
- Of 4,944 original tracked files, only the authorized additive module export and Gradle bridge differ. Public Basic model source, canonical parity ledger/reference manifest, original test data and assertions remain unchanged.

## Actual scope and pending gates

This verdict covers source/reference/hash inspection, dependency-source analysis and byte-exact retained-source diffs. No Cargo/compiler/build/test, Clippy, Gradle/SDK model execution, app launch, formatter/cache/source mutation, Git mutation or reviewer spawning occurred. The 28 declared tests are **unrun by this reviewer**. Static PASS is not compilation, runtime, full-app or feature completion. The owner still needs actual scoped locked build/unfiltered tests, repository Clippy, formatting, bridge-boundary/current official SDK probes and every other reviewer gate. Root must verify combined native/full-app/full-workspace/parity gates before merging or pushing the protected integration branch.
